name: es20-cube-map
title: Cube map textures: face selection (Table 3.21) and completeness
summary: Six 2x2 cube faces sampled with a samplerCube: a skybox, per-face tiles, 24 texel-centre, hand-derived and 1500 random directions checked against a CPU model of ES 3.0 Table 3.21, and four kinds of incomplete cube map.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.1 Texture Objects (cube map binding), §3.8.3 Texture Image Specification (cube map faces, square faces, maximum size)
ES 3.0 §3.8.9 Cube Map Texture Selection, Table 3.21, §3.8.9.1 Seamless Cube Map Filtering
GLSL ES 3.00 §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (texture with samplerCube)

api.glGenTextures: main cube map, four broken and four complete scenario cube maps
api.glBindTexture: TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP binding selects the cube map to sample; TEXTURE_BINDING_CUBE_MAP read back (and 0 after unbinding); a cube map bound to TEXTURE_2D -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glTexImage2D: six face targets POSITIVE_X..NEGATIVE_Z, each with a distinct 2x2 image; sampled texels compared with the CPU model of Table 3.21; non-square face and face above MAX_CUBE_MAP_TEXTURE_SIZE -> INVALID_VALUE; target TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP -> INVALID_ENUM; a missing, wrong-size or wrong-format face makes the cube map incomplete (samples (0,0,0,1))
api.glTexSubImage2D: overwriting one texel of the -Y face changes exactly that quadrant of the -Y tile (mutation control)
api.glTexParameteri: TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER NEAREST (via the typed wrapper) makes a base-level-only cube map complete; the default NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR leaves it incomplete
api.glGenerateMipmap: TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP: INVALID_OPERATION when not cube complete; on a complete cube map with the default filter it makes the cube map complete (face appears)
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quad for the skybox, the face tiles and the one-pixel direction probes
api.glViewport: sky, tile and one-pixel viewports; pixel positions verified
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit, sampling mode and face index
api.glUniform3f: probe direction and skybox camera vectors; the CPU evaluates the same linear ray function
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the default framebuffer for all comparisons

visual_review.notes: radeonsi es-max capture (viewed at 3x): the skybox shows three faces meeting at a corner (green +Y at the top, yellow -Z left, red +X right), each split into four brightness quadrants; the six face tiles show red, cyan, green, magenta, blue, yellow with the brightest texel top-left; the four bottom pairs show a black incomplete cube map next to the red +X face. All six captures (gpu, llvmpipe, zink at es-min and es-max) are pixel-identical.
